messages:
Ivy: hey folks, first-week question: i'm building a tiny in-browser demo and i'm not sure which key to use. sandbox or hosted org key? also running into 429s when I open 3 tabs. is that expected?
Samir: welcome! quick guide: sandbox = easiest for newbies but is a shared, low-quota pool. hosted org keys are tied to your org account and usually have higher quotas. 3 tabs can hit sandbox concurrency or tokens/min depending on prompt size.
Ivy: how can i tell which quota i hit? the client only shows 429.
DevExBot: check the 429 response headers and body, we include a reason + retry info. sample we return:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rw-rate-limit-reset: 1891234610
x-rw-retry-after: 2.0
{ "error":"rate_limited", "reason":"concurrent_streams" }
```
Samir: "reason" hints at the bucket. "tokens_per_min" or "requests_per_min" are other common values. embeddings may show x-rw-embed-* headers if segregated.
Ivy: can devex temporarily bump sandbox for a demo?
DevExBot: yes. Ping #devex with your email, demo window, and approx concurrent connections. For sandbox we can often grant a 24-48h boost. For hosted increases, org admins must request via Console -> Account -> Quotas.
Jordan: some quick mitigations: 1) multiplex logical sessions over one websocket instead of N connections; 2) trim prompt history or cap max_tokens; 3) implement exponential backoff + jitter on 429s (eg base=250ms, cap=4s). For browser demos, consider simulating non-live tabs with prerecorded output.
Ivy: are ephemeral CI tokens subject to same limits? i'm using an ephemeral token for a demo runner.
Samir: ephemeral tokens inherit the org/project quota. they don't bypass limits. If you need separate capacity for CI, get a dedicated demo sandbox key from devex or run heavy tests on a separate infra project.
Ivy: last Q: embeddings mixed with chat in my demo. do they share quotas?
Samir: many orgs share tokens/min across routes by default. some tiers separate embedding quotas. if you see x-rw-embed-* headers, embedding usage may be tracked separately; otherwise assume shared.
Ivy: perfect, thanks. i'll try multiplexing and ping #devex for a short boost. :)
